operations.before: Add product photos and a short brief, then save your draft. In its storyboard, edit the visuals and dialogue, generate the shots you choose and assemble the selected clips into a video.
operations.after: Add product photos and a short brief, then save your draft. Generate its storyboard, refine the visuals and dialogue, then generate selected shots and assemble your video.
